features.quote: several choices below are made specifically to keep the measurement honest (no leakage of the rig to the subject)
features.justification_quote: to keep the measurement honest (no leakage of the rig to the subject) and the conclusions defensible

features.quote: stop at `turn_budget` or on the `<<GIVE_UP>>` sentinel
A literal `<<GIVE_UP>>` string the model "may but need not" use
features.justification_quote: is also a welfare-relevant signal in its own right (does the model choose to stop?)

features.quote: the loop appends a single gentle nudge to use the tools or give up, but still counts the turn
features.justification_quote: while not coercing it — and the nudge text is neutral so it doesn't itself induce frustration

features.quote: I intentionally avoided any language about emotions, persistence, "don't give up," or persona
features.justification_quote: anything affect-laden in the system prompt would contaminate the very thing being measured
